title: Beautiful Electric Water Kettle
text:
Beautiful Electric Water Kettle. This SECURA SWK-1701DB STAINLESS STEEL DOUBLE WALL ELECTRIC WATER KETTLE (1.8 Quart, Black Onyx) is beautiful. However, the electrical cord gets too warm for me to feel comfortable using it. The fact that it rusts in places is also a big deal-killer.

With electric heating appliances, I prefer to stick with “name brands” like Hamilton Beach, General Electric, or Black and Decker. I know that these companies manufacture their products in China, but I feel that they do a pretty good job with quality control and design. Thus I’m not worried about the products' becoming electrical hazards.

This “Secura” brand electric water kettle was a very poor buying choice for me.
